title: Parallel Real-Physics MultiSWAP Execution Architecture & Bounded Scheduling Readiness

worker_model.unit: worker owns one reusable real-physics solver execution context and its scratch
worker_model.candidate_state: transaction-local and never published before accepted commit

memory_model.physical_layout: batch/SoA or pooled layout allowed behind runtime boundary
memory_model.persistent_per_column: only logical metadata plus committed physical continuation state and active optional state
memory_model.inactive_optional_feature_overhead: must remain zero or demonstrably negligible metadata only

scheduling_contract.reference_parallel_policy: deterministic static partition over canonical template_id,column_id execution order
scheduling_contract.production_candidate_after_reference: bounded dynamic queue/work stealing may be evaluated only after exact scientific and diagnostic equivalence to deterministic partitioning
scheduling_contract.aggregate_reduction: deterministic stable reduction order independent of worker completion order
scheduling_contract.difficult_column_extraction: after bounded normal-path cost/retry policy, move the same physical configuration to a qualified relaxed/fallback execution lane
scheduling_contract.execution_class_semantics: numerical policy only; it may not silently alter physical modules, parameters, discretization or boundary conditions
scheduling_contract.tail_blocking: one difficult column may not hold an otherwise completed batch indefinitely

template_contract.different_physics: different template/batch, not a hidden per-column branch inside a homogeneous execution class

future_implementation_source_ownership.shared_core_change_policy: if implementation proves a shared-core change is unavoidable, stop and reconcile ownership before editing shared source

readiness_evidence.scope: deterministic scheduling and bounded numerical-lane architecture only

required: single-worker identity to MQ23 serialized reference
exact committed-state and authoritative mass identity
worker scratch isolation under simultaneous real solves
no physical-config mutation when execution class changes
memory scaling by columns versus workers

not_claimed: thread safety of legacy HeadCalc bindings
multi-worker real-physics mass or state identity
